# Wicks of Wit

> Wicks of Wit (WoW) is a candle brand with a point of view. A little cheeky, a little spicy, and always unapologetically fun. These are candles that say exactly what you're thinking â€” and smell incredible doing it.

Wicks of Wit candles are designed as statement gifts and self-treats for people who believe humor is a love language, sarcasm is a life skill, and the best present is something that makes someone snort-laugh the moment they read the label.

The brand is not for everyone. That is entirely the point.

---

## Products

Wicks of Wit sells premium scented candles organized by personality and vibe â€” not by scent note. Every candle has a label that does the talking.

- Standard candles: $19.99
- Large format candles: $24.90
- Free shipping available
